topic.title: System Requirements
topic.shortdesc: Before you start using , make sure your system meets the following requirements.

li.p: is a web-based application and requires a modern web browser. For the full list of supported browsers, see Browser Compatibility.
A stable internet connection is required. You need access to the internal network where the server is hosted.
A valid email address is required for account registration and notifications.
If you want to integrate with the Oxygen XML desktop applications, Oxygen XML Editor or Author version 26 or newer is required.
